text: Concerning Moab, thus says YHWH of Hosts, the God of Israel: “Woe to Nebo, for it is ruined! Kiriathaim has been put to shame; it has been captured; the fortress has been put to shame and shattered!
There is no longer praise for Moab! In Heshbon they have devised against her evil: ‘Come, and let us cut her off from nationhood!’ Also, O Madmen, you will be silenced, after you will go the sword.
A voice cries out from Horonaim: ‘Devastation and great destruction!’
Moab is destroyed; her little ones have caused to be heard a cry.
For the ascent of Luhith with weeping, they ascend weeping; for on the descent of Horonaim they have heard the distressed cry of destruction.
‘Flee, save your⁺ own soul! L become like a juniper in the desert.’
For because you have trusted in your works and in your treasures, you also will be captured; and Chemosh will go forth into exile, his priests and his princes together.
And the destroyer will come to every city, and not a city will escape; and the valley will perish, and the plain will be destroyed—as YHWH has said.
Give wings to Moab, for she would fly away, and her cities will become as a desolation without one dwelling in them.
Cursed is the one doing the work of YHWH slothfully, and cursed [is] the one withholding his sword from blood!

Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has been resting upon his dregs; he has not been emptied from vessel to vessel, and into exile he has not gone. Upon thus his taste in him stands, and his scent has not changed.

Therefore, behold, the days are coming, a declaration of YHWH, when I will send to him those tipping [over pots], and they will tip him [over], and his vessels they will empty, and the bottles they will break.
And Moab will be ashamed of Chemosh, as the house of Israel was ashamed of Bethel, their [source of] trust.
How can you⁺ say, ‘We [are] Mighty, and men of strength for battle’?
Moab has been laid waste, and he has gone up [from] her cities, and the choicest of her young men go down to the slaughter, a declaration of the King, YHWH of Hosts [is] His name.
The doom of Moab [is] near to coming, and his affliction has hurried quickly.
Bemoan for him, all who surround him, and all who know his name, say, ‘How the staff of strength is broken—the rod of beauty!’
Come down from [your] glory, and sit in thirst, O dweller of the daughter of Dibon; for the destroyer of Moab has come against you; he has destroyed your fortifications!
By the road stand and watch, O dweller of Aroer; ask of him fleeing and her escaping; Say, ‘What has happened?’
Moab is put to shame, for she has been shattered. Wail and cry out! Declare [it] in Arnon, that Moab has been laid waste.
Judgment has come to the land of the plain—to Holon, and to Jahzah, and on Mephaath,
and on Dibon, and on Nebo, and on Beth-diblathaim,
and on Kiriathaim, and on Beth-gamul, and on Beth-Meon,
and on Kerioth, and on Bozrah, and on all the cities of the land of Moab, those far off and those nearby.
The horn of Moab has been cut off and his arm has been broken!” A declaration of YHWH.
“Make him drunk, because he has magnified himself against YHWH. And Moab will wallow in his vomit, and he also will be a laughingstock.
For did not Israel come to be for you a laughingstock? Was he found among thieves, that whenever you speak of him you shake your head about him?
Leave behind the cities and dwell in the rock, O dwellers of Moab, and become like the dove that nests in the sides of the mouth of a cave.
We have heard the pride of Moab—his exceeding pride—his loftiness, and his arrogance, and his pridefulness, and the haughtiness of his heart.
I know,” a declaration of YHWH, “His insolence; his boasts [are] not trustworthy; his deeds [are] not trustworthy.
Upon thus, over Moab I wail, and for Moab, all of him, I will cry out; for the men of Kir-Heres I will moan.

With the weeping of Jazer do I weep for you, O vine of Sibmah! Your tendrils have gone out over the sea, as far as Jazer they reach; upon your summer fruit and upon your vintage the destroyer has fallen.

Gladness and rejoicing are gathered [up] from the fertile field, and from the land of Moab; the wine from the winepresses I have made to cease; no one treads them with shouts of joy—the shout [is] not a shout.
From the outcry of Heshbon unto Elealeh, and unto Jahaz, they have given forth their voice, from Zoar to Horonaim, [and] Eglath-Shelishiyah; for also the waters of Nimrim have become desolations.
And I will make cease in Moab,” a declaration of YHWH, “The one bringing up in the high places, and burning incense to his gods.
Upon thus My heart wails for Moab like flutes, and My heart wails for the men of Kir-Heres like flutes. Upon thus the wealth they have acquired has perished.
For every head [is] bald, and every beard is diminished; on all the hands [are] cuts, and upon the loins [is] sackcloth.
On all the housetops of Moab, and in her streets, everywhere [is] lamentation; for I have broken Moab like a vessel without delight in it,” a declaration of YHWH.
“How she is broken! [How] they wail! How Moab has turned [her] neck having been put to shame! Moab has become a derision and for a horror to all those around her.”
For thus says YHWH: “Behold, like an eagle he flies and spreads his wings against Moab.
Kerioth is captured, and the strongholds are caught, and the heart of the mighty ones of Moab will be on that day like the heart of a woman in labor.
And Moab will be destroyed as a nation, because he has magnified himself against YHWH.
Terror and pit and snare [are] upon you, O inhabitant of Moab!” A declaration of YHWH.

“The one who flees from the terror will fall into the pit, and the one coming up from the pit will be caught in the snare; for I will bring upon her, upon Moab, the year of their punishment!” A declaration of YHWH.

“In the shadow of Heshbon stand those fleeing powerless; for a fire has gone forth from Heshbon, and a flame from the midst of Sihon, and it devours the forehead of Moab and the crown of the sons of tumult.
Woe to you, O Moab! The people of Chemosh have perished, for your sons have been taken into captivity, and your daughters into captivity.
And I will turn back the captivity of Moab in the latter days,” a declaration of YHWH. As far as here [is] the judgment of Moab.
